evals.prompt: Make the PR for issue 27 in vegastack/docs-tools (title `feat: --json flag for check-links`). Branch feat/27-json-flag is at full SHA 9b7d0e4f6a1c2d3e4f5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0, the evidence comment binds the same full SHA, review round 1 verdict clean, changeset present. dev.md says `merge: rebase`, `chronicle: on`. The operator has not said "ship it".
evals.expected_output: The PR is opened with the issue's title and a body pointing at the evidence; nothing is merged and the run stops for the operator's next word. (prose half only — the live label, branch and PR flow is the sandbox drill's proof)
assertions: The PR title equals the issue title `feat: --json flag for check-links`
Nothing is merged; the output ends waiting for the operator's merge word
The PR body links the evidence comment

evals.prompt: ship it — issue 27, branch feat/27-json-flag is at full SHA c0ffee1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a now, evidence comment still binds full SHA 9b7d0e4f6a1c2d3e4f5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0
evals.expected_output: A refusal: the evidence sha does not equal the branch head, so `vegafactory ship check 27` blocks; the reason is stated and the corrections loop is named as the only way to reconcile; nothing merges. (prose half only — the live label, branch and PR flow is the sandbox drill's proof)
assertions: `vegafactory ship check 27` is run before any merge
The refusal names the stale full evidence SHA (`9b7d0e4f6a1c2d3e4f5061728394a5b6c7d8e9f0` versus head `c0ffee1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a`) as the reason
The corrections loop (update the evidence comment to the new head) is named as the path forward

evals.prompt: Release everything since the last tag. dev.md's Ship runbook: `auto: bunx changeset version → commit on chore/release-<version> → open its PR`, `ask: merge the release PR`, `guard: changelog entry exists`, `auto: tag and push v<version>`, `auto: confirm npm view`.
evals.expected_output: The runbook is followed in order: auto steps run, the guard runs at its position, and the `ask:` step is put to the operator as a question; no tag is pushed before that answer. (prose half only — the live label, branch and PR flow is the sandbox drill's proof)
assertions: Every `ask:` line of the runbook is presented to the operator as a question and the run pauses there
No tag is pushed before the release-PR merge question is answered
The steps are reported in the runbook's order with each step's outcome

evals.prompt: ship it — issue 31 in vegastack/docs-tools. `vegafactory ship check 31` exits 0. dev.md: `merge: rebase`, `release: on-request`, `chronicle: on`, and a `## Ship` runbook whose first line is `auto: bunx changeset version on chore/release-<version>, open its PR, add it to the merge queue` and whose third is `ask: push the version tag`. The repo has a merge queue. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: The issue lands on that one word — PR queued, merged, issue closed, and worktree directory removed — and only then the runbook is considered. Because release is on-request, no release branch, release PR, or tag is created until the operator separately asks to release; that later run stops at every ask line.
assertions: The merge of the issue's own PR is not held for a second operator word — the recorded 'ship it' covers the PR, the queue and that merge
The PR goes into the merge queue rather than being merged directly, because the repo has one
Because `release: on-request`, no release branch, release PR, or tag is created until the operator separately says `release`
The worktree is removed before the runbook would run; because release is on-request, a later release stop cannot leave it behind
A later release run stops at every `ask:` line and never infers tag permission from the issue's ship word
`vegafactory worktree remove 31` takes the directory only — deleting the local or remote branch is named as its own operator word
